messages.subject: Penrose v Caldervale - mediation?
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Now that expert reports have been exchanged, our client is willing in principle to mediate. Would your client consider a one-day mediation in the new year, perhaps late January? We have used CEDR panel mediators before.

Martin Greaves

messages.subject: RE: Penrose v Caldervale - mediation?
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Greaves,

Our client is willing to mediate and a late-January date works. Given the expert evidence now strongly supports our client's causation case, our client will come prepared to discuss a commercial resolution but expects to recover a substantial proportion of the Outstanding Sums. We'll propose three mediator names shortly.

Sarah
